title: Newhalo hero
description: A window-tall black panel inset 6–10px from the edge with 8px corners, filled edge to edge by a video slot that drifts down ~108px as you scroll the first screen. A giant 280px wordmark sits bottom-left on desktop, a 64px (or two-line 100px) title bottom-right, and an orange play button trails the cursor; on phones the title and play button stack bottom-left.
notes: sized by the window (h-svh); pair it with newhalo-header, which floats over it
always dark (wraps itself in .dark); tone warm suits an orange video
